verses.ar: بِسۡمِ اللّٰہِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ ﴿۱﴾
verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
Ha Mim.[✛]

verses.ar: تَنۡزِیۡلٌ مِّنَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ ۚ﴿۳﴾
verses.en: This is a revelation from the Gracious, the Merciful.

verses.ar: کِتٰبٌ فُصِّلَتۡ اٰیٰتُہٗ قُرۡاٰنًا عَرَبِیًّا لِّقَوۡمٍ یَّعۡلَمُوۡنَ ۙ﴿۴﴾
verses.en: [✲]A Book, the verses of which have been expounded in detail — the Qur’an in clear, eloquent language —  for a people who have knowledge,

verses.ar: بَشِیۡرًا وَّنَذِیۡرًا ۚ فَاَعۡرَضَ اَکۡثَرُہُمۡ فَہُمۡ لَا یَسۡمَعُوۡنَ ﴿۵﴾
verses.en: A bringer of glad tidings and a warner. But most of them turn away and they hear not.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا قُلُوۡبُنَا فِیۡۤ اَکِنَّۃٍ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُوۡنَاۤ اِلَیۡہِ وَفِیۡۤ اٰذَانِنَا وَقۡرٌ وَّمِنۡۢ بَیۡنِنَا وَبَیۡنِکَ حِجَابٌ فَاعۡمَلۡ اِنَّنَا عٰمِلُوۡنَ ؓ﴿۶﴾
verses.en: And they say: ‘Our hearts are under covers and are protected against that to which thou callest us, and in our ears there is a deafness, and [✲]between us and thee there is a screen. So carry on thy work; we too are working.’

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُکُمۡ یُوۡحٰۤی اِلَیَّ اَنَّمَاۤ اِلٰـہُکُمۡ اِلٰہٌ وَّاحِدٌ فَاسۡتَقِیۡمُوۡۤا اِلَیۡہِ وَاسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡہُ ؕ وَوَیۡلٌ لِّلۡمُشۡرِکِیۡنَ ۙ﴿۷﴾
verses.en: Say, ‘I am only a man like you. It is revealed to me that your God is One God; so go ye straight to Him without deviating, and ask forgiveness of Him.’ And woe to the idolaters,

verses.ar: الَّذِیۡنَ لَا یُؤۡتُوۡنَ الزَّکٰوۃَ وَہُمۡ بِالۡاٰخِرَۃِ ہُمۡ کٰفِرُوۡنَ ﴿۸﴾
verses.en: Who give not the Zakat, and they it is who deny the Hereafter.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِیۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَہُمۡ اَجۡرٌ غَیۡرُ مَمۡنُوۡنٍ ﴿٪۹﴾
verses.en: As to those who believe and do good works, they will surely have a reward that will never end.

verses.ar: قُلۡ اَئِنَّکُمۡ لَتَکۡفُرُوۡنَ بِالَّذِیۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَرۡضَ فِیۡ یَوۡمَیۡنِ وَتَجۡعَلُوۡنَ لَہٗۤ اَنۡدَادًا ؕ ذٰلِکَ رَبُّ الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ ۚ﴿۱۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]Say: ‘Do you really disbelieve in Him Who created the earth in two days? And do you set up equals to  Him?’ That is the Lord of the worlds.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلَ فِیۡہَا رَوَاسِیَ مِنۡ فَوۡقِہَا وَبٰرَکَ فِیۡہَا وَقَدَّرَ فِیۡہَاۤ اَقۡوَاتَہَا فِیۡۤ اَرۡبَعَۃِ اَیَّامٍ ؕ سَوَآءً لِّلسَّآئِلِیۡنَ ﴿۱۱﴾
verses.en: [✲]He placed therein firm mountains rising above its surface, and blessed it with abundance, and provided therein its foods in proper measure in four days — alike for all seekers.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اسۡتَوٰۤی اِلَی السَّمَآءِ وَہِیَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَہَا وَلِلۡاَرۡضِ ائۡتِیَا طَوۡعًا اَوۡ کَرۡہًا ؕ قَالَتَاۤ اَتَیۡنَا طَآئِعِیۡنَ ﴿۱۲﴾
verses.en: Then He turned to the heaven while it was something like smoke, and said to it and to the earth: ‘Come ye both of you, willingly or unwillingly.’ They said, ‘We come willingly.’

verses.ar: فَقَضٰہُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمٰوَاتٍ فِیۡ یَوۡمَیۡنِ وَاَوۡحٰی فِیۡ کُلِّ سَمَآءٍ اَمۡرَہَا ؕ وَزَیَّنَّا السَّمَآءَ الدُّنۡیَا بِمَصَابِیۡحَ ٭ۖ وَحِفۡظًا ؕ ذٰلِکَ تَقۡدِیۡرُ الۡعَزِیۡزِ الۡعَلِیۡمِ ﴿۱۳﴾
verses.en: So He completed them into seven heavens in two days, and He revealed to each heaven its function. And We adorned the lowest heaven with lamps for light and for protection. That is the decree of the Mighty, the All-Knowing.

verses.ar: فَاِنۡ اَعۡرَضُوۡا فَقُلۡ اَنۡذَرۡتُکُمۡ صٰعِقَۃً مِّثۡلَ صٰعِقَۃِ عَادٍ وَّثَمُوۡدَ ﴿ؕ۱۴﴾
verses.en: But if they turn away, then say: ‘I warn you of a destructive punishment like the punishment which overtook ‘Ad and Thamud.’

verses.ar: اِذۡ جَآءَتۡہُمُ الرُّسُلُ مِنۡۢ بَیۡنِ اَیۡدِیۡہِمۡ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِہِمۡ اَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡۤا اِلَّا اللّٰہَ ؕ قَالُوۡا لَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَاَنۡزَلَ مَلٰٓئِکَۃً فَاِنَّا بِمَاۤ اُرۡسِلۡتُمۡ بِہٖ کٰفِرُوۡنَ ﴿۱۵﴾
verses.en: When their Messengers came to them from before them and behind them, saying: ‘Worship none but Allah,’ they said: ‘If our Lord had so willed, He would have certainly sent down angels. So we do disbelieve in that with which you have been sent.’
w: He would have certainly sent down

verses.ar: فَاَمَّا عَادٌ فَاسۡتَکۡبَرُوۡا فِی الۡاَرۡضِ بِغَیۡرِ الۡحَقِّ وَقَالُوۡا مَنۡ اَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّۃً ؕ اَوَلَمۡ یَرَوۡا اَنَّ اللّٰہَ الَّذِیۡ خَلَقَہُمۡ ہُوَ اَشَدُّ مِنۡہُمۡ قُوَّۃً ؕ وَکَانُوۡا بِاٰیٰتِنَا یَجۡحَدُوۡنَ ﴿۱۶﴾
verses.en: As for ‘Ad, they behaved arrogantly in the earth without any justification and said, ‘Who is mightier than we in power?’ Do they not see that Allah, Who created them, is mightier than they in power? Still they continued to deny Our Signs.

verses.ar: فَاَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَیۡہِمۡ رِیۡحًا صَرۡصَرًا فِیۡۤ اَیَّامٍ نَّحِسَاتٍ لِّنُذِیۡقَہُمۡ عَذَابَ الۡخِزۡیِ فِی الۡحَیٰوۃِ الدُّنۡیَا ؕ وَلَعَذَابُ الۡاٰخِرَۃِ اَخۡزٰی وَہُمۡ لَا یُنۡصَرُوۡنَ ﴿۱۷﴾
verses.en: So We sent upon them a furious wind for several ominous days, that We might make them taste the  punishment of humiliation in this life. And the punishment of the Hereafter will surely be more humiliating, and they will not be helped.
w: that We might make them taste
and the punishment will surely be

verses.ar: وَاَمَّا ثَمُوۡدُ فَہَدَیۡنٰہُمۡ فَاسۡتَحَبُّوا الۡعَمٰی عَلَی الۡہُدٰی فَاَخَذَتۡہُمۡ صٰعِقَۃُ الۡعَذَابِ الۡہُوۡنِ بِمَا کَانُوۡا یَکۡسِبُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۱۸﴾
verses.en: And as for Thamud, We gave them guidance, but they preferred blindness to guidance, so the calamity of a humiliating punishment seized them, on account of what they had earned.

verses.ar: وَنَجَّیۡنَا الَّذِیۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَکَانُوۡا یَتَّقُوۡنَ ﴿٪۱۹﴾
verses.en: And We saved those who believed and acted righteously.

verses.ar: وَیَوۡمَ یُحۡشَرُ اَعۡدَآءُ اللّٰہِ اِلَی النَّارِ فَہُمۡ یُوۡزَعُوۡنَ ﴿۲۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]And on the day when the enemies of Allah will be gathered together and driven to the Fire, they will be goaded on.

verses.ar: حَتّٰۤی اِذَا مَا جَآءُوۡہَا شَہِدَ عَلَیۡہِمۡ سَمۡعُہُمۡ وَاَبۡصَارُہُمۡ وَجُلُوۡدُہُمۡ بِمَا کَانُوۡا یَعۡمَلُوۡنَ ﴿۲۱﴾
verses.en: Till, when they reach it, their ears and their eyes and their skins will bear witness against them as to what they had been doing.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لِجُلُوۡدِہِمۡ لِمَ شَہِدۡتُّمۡ عَلَیۡنَا ؕ قَالُوۡۤا اَنۡطَقَنَا اللّٰہُ الَّذِیۡۤ اَنۡطَقَ کُلَّ شَیۡءٍ وَّہُوَ خَلَقَکُمۡ اَوَّلَ مَرَّۃٍ وَّاِلَیۡہِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ ﴿۲۲﴾
verses.en: And they will say to their skins: ‘Why bear ye witness against us?’ They will say: ‘Allah has made us to speak as He has made everything else to speak. And He it is Who created you the first time, and unto Him have you been brought back.

verses.ar: وَمَا کُنۡتُمۡ تَسۡتَتِرُوۡنَ اَنۡ یَّشۡہَدَ عَلَیۡکُمۡ سَمۡعُکُمۡ وَلَاۤ اَبۡصَارُکُمۡ وَلَا جُلُوۡدُکُمۡ وَلٰکِنۡ ظَنَنۡتُمۡ اَنَّ اللّٰہَ لَا یَعۡلَمُ کَثِیۡرًا مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ ﴿۲۳﴾
verses.en: ‘And you did not fear while committing sins that your ears and your eyes and your skins would bear witness against you, nay, you thought that even Allah did not know much of what you used to do.

verses.ar: وَذٰلِکُمۡ ظَنُّکُمُ الَّذِیۡ ظَنَنۡتُمۡ بِرَبِّکُمۡ اَرۡدٰٮکُمۡ فَاَصۡبَحۡتُمۡ مِّنَ الۡخٰسِرِیۡنَ ﴿۲۴﴾
verses.en: ‘And that thought of yours, which you entertained concerning your Lord, has ruined you. So now you have become of those who are lost.’

verses.ar: فَاِنۡ یَّصۡبِرُوۡا فَالنَّارُ مَثۡوًی لَّہُمۡ ۚ وَاِنۡ یَّسۡتَعۡتِبُوۡا فَمَا ہُمۡ مِّنَ الۡمُعۡتَبِیۡنَ ﴿۲۵﴾
verses.en: [✲]Now if they can endure, the Fire is their abode; and if they ask for  forgiveness, they are not of those whom forgiveness can be shown.
w: those whom forgiveness can be shown

verses.ar: وَقَیَّضۡنَا لَہُمۡ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَیَّنُوۡا لَہُمۡ مَّا بَیۡنَ اَیۡدِیۡہِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَہُمۡ وَحَقَّ عَلَیۡہِمُ الۡقَوۡلُ فِیۡۤ اُمَمٍ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِنۡ قَبۡلِہِمۡ مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ وَالۡاِنۡسِ ۚ اِنَّہُمۡ کَانُوۡا خٰسِرِیۡنَ ﴿٪۲۶﴾
verses.en: [✲]And We had assigned for them companions who made to appear attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them; and the sentence became due against them along with the communities of Jinn and mankind that had gone before them. Surely, they were the losers.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِیۡنَ کَفَرُوۡا لَا تَسۡمَعُوۡا لِہٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنِ وَالۡغَوۡا فِیۡہِ لَعَلَّکُمۡ تَغۡلِبُوۡنَ ﴿۲۷﴾
verses.en: And those who disbelieve say: ‘Listen not to this Qur’an, but make noise during its recital that you may have the upper hand.’

verses.ar: فَلَنُذِیۡقَنَّ الَّذِیۡنَ کَفَرُوۡا عَذَابًا شَدِیۡدًا ۙ وَّلَنَجۡزِیَنَّہُمۡ اَسۡوَاَ الَّذِیۡ کَانُوۡا یَعۡمَلُوۡنَ ﴿۲۸﴾
verses.en: And most certainly We will make those who disbelieve taste a severe punishment, and, most certainly, We will requite them for the worst of their deeds.
w: and most certainly We will make taste
and, most certainly, We will requite them

verses.ar: ذٰلِکَ جَزَآءُ اَعۡدَآءِ اللّٰہِ النَّارُ ۚ لَہُمۡ فِیۡہَا دَارُ الۡخُلۡدِ ؕ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا کَانُوۡا بِاٰیٰتِنَا یَجۡحَدُوۡنَ ﴿۲۹﴾
verses.en: That is the reward of the enemies of Allah — the Fire. For them there will be an abiding home therein as a requital because they used to deny Our Signs.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِیۡنَ کَفَرُوۡا رَبَّنَاۤ اَرِنَا الَّذَیۡنِ اَضَلّٰنَا مِنَ الۡجِنِّ وَالۡاِنۡسِ نَجۡعَلۡہُمَا تَحۡتَ اَقۡدَامِنَا لِیَکُوۡنَا مِنَ الۡاَسۡفَلِیۡنَ ﴿۳۰﴾
verses.en: And those who disbelieve will say, ‘Our Lord, show us those who led us astray from among both the Jinn and men, that we may put them under our feet so that both of them may become of the lowest.’
w: so that both of them may become

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِیۡنَ قَالُوۡا رَبُّنَا اللّٰہُ ثُمَّ اسۡتَقَامُوۡا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَیۡہِمُ الۡمَلٰٓئِکَۃُ اَلَّا تَخَافُوۡا وَلَا تَحۡزَنُوۡا وَاَبۡشِرُوۡا بِالۡجَنَّۃِ الَّتِیۡ کُنۡتُمۡ تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ ﴿۳۱﴾
verses.en: As for those who say, ‘Our Lord is Allah,’ and then remain steadfast, the angels descend on them, saying: ‘Fear ye not, nor grieve; and rejoice in the Garden that you were promised.

verses.ar: نَحۡنُ اَوۡلِیٰٓؤُکُمۡ فِی الۡحَیٰوۃِ الدُّنۡیَا وَفِی الۡاٰخِرَۃِ ۚ وَلَکُمۡ فِیۡہَا مَا تَشۡتَہِیۡۤ اَنۡفُسُکُمۡ وَلَکُمۡ فِیۡہَا مَا تَدَّعُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۳۲﴾
verses.en: ‘We are your friends in this life and in the Hereafter. Therein you will have all that your souls will  desire, and therein you will have all that you will ask for —

verses.ar: نُزُلًا مِّنۡ غَفُوۡرٍ رَّحِیۡمٍ ﴿٪۳۳﴾
verses.en: ‘An entertainment from the Most Forgiving, the Merciful.’

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ اَحۡسَنُ قَوۡلًا مِّمَّنۡ دَعَاۤ اِلَی اللّٰہِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا وَّقَالَ اِنَّنِیۡ مِنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِیۡنَ ﴿۳۴﴾
verses.en: And who is better in speech than he who invites men to Allah and does good works and says, ‘I am surely of those who submit?’

verses.ar: وَلَا تَسۡتَوِی الۡحَسَنَۃُ وَلَا السَّیِّئَۃُ ؕ اِدۡفَعۡ بِالَّتِیۡ ہِیَ اَحۡسَنُ فَاِذَا الَّذِیۡ بَیۡنَکَ وَبَیۡنَہٗ عَدَاوَۃٌ کَاَنَّہٗ وَلِیٌّ حَمِیۡمٌ ﴿۳۵﴾
verses.en: And good and evil are not alike. Repel evil with that which is best. And lo, he between whom and thyself was enmity will become as though he were a warm friend.
w: will become as though he were

verses.ar: وَمَا یُلَقّٰہَاۤ اِلَّا الَّذِیۡنَ صَبَرُوۡا ۚ وَمَا یُلَقّٰہَاۤ اِلَّا ذُوۡ حَظٍّ عَظِیۡمٍ ﴿۳۶﴾
verses.en: [✲]But none is granted it save those who are steadfast; and none is granted it save those who possess a large share of good.

verses.ar: وَاِمَّا یَنۡزَغَنَّکَ مِنَ الشَّیۡطٰنِ نَزۡغٌ فَاسۡتَعِذۡ بِاللّٰہِ ؕ اِنَّہٗ ہُوَ السَّمِیۡعُ الۡعَلِیۡمُ ﴿۳۷﴾
verses.en: And if an incitement from Satan incite thee, then seek refuge in Allah. Surely He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

verses.ar: وَمِنۡ اٰیٰتِہِ الَّیۡلُ وَالنَّہَارُ وَالشَّمۡسُ وَالۡقَمَرُ ؕ لَا تَسۡجُدُوۡا لِلشَّمۡسِ وَلَا لِلۡقَمَرِ وَاسۡجُدُوۡا لِلّٰہِ الَّذِیۡ خَلَقَہُنَّ اِنۡ کُنۡتُمۡ اِیَّاہُ تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ ﴿۳۸﴾
verses.en: And among His Signs are the night and the day and the sun and the moon. Prostrate not yourselves before the sun, nor before the moon, but prostrate yourselves before Allah, Who created them, if it is Him Whom you really worship.

verses.ar: فَاِنِ اسۡتَکۡبَرُوۡا فَالَّذِیۡنَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّکَ یُسَبِّحُوۡنَ لَہٗ بِالَّیۡلِ وَالنَّہَارِ وَہُمۡ لَا یَسۡـَٔمُوۡنَ ﴿ٛ۳۹﴾
verses.en: But if they turn away with disdain they do it to their own detriment, while those who are with thy Lord glorify Him night and day, and they are never wearied.
w: they turn away with disdain they do it to their own detriment

verses.ar: وَمِنۡ اٰیٰتِہٖۤ اَنَّکَ تَرَی الۡاَرۡضَ خَاشِعَۃً فَاِذَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَیۡہَا الۡمَآءَ اہۡتَزَّتۡ وَرَبَتۡ ؕ اِنَّ الَّذِیۡۤ اَحۡیَاہَا لَمُحۡیِ الۡمَوۡتٰی ؕ اِنَّہٗ عَلٰی کُلِّ شَیۡءٍ قَدِیۡرٌ ﴿۴۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]And among His Signs is this: that thou seest the earth lying withered, but when We send down water on it, it stirs and swells with verdure. Surely, He Who quickened it can quicken the dead. Verily He has power over all things.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِیۡنَ یُلۡحِدُوۡنَ فِیۡۤ اٰیٰتِنَا لَا یَخۡفَوۡنَ عَلَیۡنَا ؕ اَفَمَنۡ یُّلۡقٰی فِی النَّارِ خَیۡرٌ اَمۡ مَّنۡ یَّاۡتِیۡۤ اٰمِنًا یَّوۡمَ الۡقِیٰمَۃِ ؕ اِعۡمَلُوۡا مَا شِئۡتُمۡ ۙ اِنَّہٗ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ بَصِیۡرٌ ﴿۴۱﴾
verses.en: [✲]Surely, those who deviate from the right path with respect to Our Signs are not hidden from Us. Is he, then, who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes out safe on the Day of Resurrection? Do what you will. Surely He sees all that you do.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِیۡنَ کَفَرُوۡا بِالذِّکۡرِ لَمَّا جَآءَہُمۡ ۚ وَاِنَّہٗ لَکِتٰبٌ عَزِیۡزٌ ﴿ۙ۴۲﴾
verses.en: Those who disbelieve in the Reminder when it comes to them are the losers. And, truly, it is a mighty Book.
w: it comes to them are the losers

verses.ar: لَّا یَاۡتِیۡہِ الۡبَاطِلُ مِنۡۢ بَیۡنِ یَدَیۡہِ وَلَا مِنۡ خَلۡفِہٖ ؕ تَنۡزِیۡلٌ مِّنۡ حَکِیۡمٍ حَمِیۡدٍ ﴿۴۳﴾
verses.en: Falsehood cannot approach it either from before or from behind it. It is a revelation from the Wise, the Praiseworthy.

verses.ar: مَا یُقَالُ لَکَ اِلَّا مَا قَدۡ قِیۡلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِنۡ قَبۡلِکَ ؕ اِنَّ رَبَّکَ لَذُوۡ مَغۡفِرَۃٍ وَّذُوۡ عِقَابٍ اَلِیۡمٍ ﴿۴۴﴾
verses.en: Nothing is said to thee but what was said to the Messengers before thee. Thy Lord is indeed the Master of forgiveness; and also the Master of painful chastisement.

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ جَعَلۡنٰہُ قُرۡاٰنًا اَعۡجَمِیًّا لَّقَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا فُصِّلَتۡ اٰیٰتُہٗ ؕ ءَؔاَعۡجَمِیٌّ وَّعَرَبِیٌّ ؕ قُلۡ ہُوَ لِلَّذِیۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا ہُدًی وَّشِفَآءٌ ؕ وَالَّذِیۡنَ لَا یُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ فِیۡۤ اٰذَانِہِمۡ وَقۡرٌ وَّہُوَ عَلَیۡہِمۡ عَمًی ؕ اُولٰٓئِکَ یُنَادَوۡنَ مِنۡ مَّکَانٍۭ بَعِیۡدٍ ﴿٪۴۵﴾
verses.en: And if We had made it a Qur’an in a foreign tongue, they surely would have said, ‘Why have not its verses been made clear? What! a foreign tongue and an Arab?’ Say, ‘It is a guidance and a healing for those who believe.’ But as to those who believe not, there is a deafness in their ears, and it is blindness for them. They are, as it were, being called to from a far off place.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَیۡنَا مُوۡسَی الۡکِتٰبَ فَاخۡتُلِفَ فِیۡہِ ؕ وَلَوۡلَا کَلِمَۃٌ سَبَقَتۡ مِنۡ رَّبِّکَ لَقُضِیَ بَیۡنَہُمۡ ؕ وَاِنَّہُمۡ لَفِیۡ شَکٍّ مِّنۡہُ مُرِیۡبٍ ﴿۴۶﴾
verses.en: And We did give Moses the Book, but differences were created concerning it; and had it not been for a word that had gone before from thy Lord, the matter would have been decided between them; and certainly they are in a disquieting doubt about it.
w: and had it not been for

verses.ar: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفۡسِہٖ وَمَنۡ اَسَآءَ فَعَلَیۡہَا ؕ وَمَا رَبُّکَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلۡعَبِیۡدِ ﴿۴۷﴾
verses.en: Whoso does right, it is for his own soul; and whoso does evil, it will only go against it. And thy Lord is not at all unjust to His servants.
w: it is for his own soul

verses.ar: اِلَیۡہِ یُرَدُّ عِلۡمُ السَّاعَۃِ ؕ وَمَا تَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ ثَمَرٰتٍ مِّنۡ اَکۡمَامِہَا وَمَا تَحۡمِلُ مِنۡ اُنۡثٰی وَلَا تَضَعُ اِلَّا بِعِلۡمِہٖ ؕ وَیَوۡمَ یُنَادِیۡہِمۡ اَیۡنَ شُرَکَآءِیۡ ۙ قَالُوۡۤا اٰذَنّٰکَ ۙ مَا مِنَّا مِنۡ شَہِیۡدٍ ﴿ۚ۴۸﴾
verses.en: [✲]To Him alone is referred the knowledge of the Hour. And no fruits come forth from their spathes, nor does any female bear a child, nor does she give birth to it, but with His knowledge. And on the day when He will call unto them, saying, “Where are My ‘Partners’?” they will say, ‘We declare unto Thee, not one of us is a witness thereto.’

verses.ar: وَضَلَّ عَنۡہُمۡ مَّا کَانُوۡا یَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَظَنُّوۡا مَا لَہُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّحِیۡصٍ ﴿۴۹﴾
verses.en: [✲]And all that they used to call upon before will be lost to them, and they will know for certain that they have no place of escape.
w: and they will know for certain

verses.ar: لَا یَسۡـَٔمُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ مِنۡ دُعَآءِ الۡخَیۡرِ ۫ وَاِنۡ مَّسَّہُ الشَّرُّ فَیَـُٔوۡسٌ قَنُوۡطٌ ﴿۵۰﴾
verses.en: Man does not tire of praying for good; but if evil touch him, he despairs, and gives up all hope.

verses.ar: وَلَئِنۡ اَذَقۡنٰہُ رَحۡمَۃً مِّنَّا مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡہُ لَیَقُوۡلَنَّ ہٰذَا لِیۡ ۙ وَمَاۤ اَظُنُّ السَّاعَۃَ قَآئِمَۃً ۙ وَّلَئِنۡ رُّجِعۡتُ اِلٰی رَبِّیۡۤ اِنَّ لِیۡ عِنۡدَہٗ لَلۡحُسۡنٰی ۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ الَّذِیۡنَ کَفَرُوۡا بِمَا عَمِلُوۡا ۫ وَلَنُذِیۡقَنَّہُمۡ مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ غَلِیۡظٍ ﴿۵۱﴾
verses.en: And if We make him taste of mercy from Ourself, after some affliction that has befallen him, he will surely say, ‘This is my due; and I do not think the Hour will ever come. But if I am returned to my Lord, I shall surely have with Him the very best.’ Then We will surely tell the disbelievers all that they did, and We will certainly make them taste hard punishment.
w: and We will certainly make them taste

verses.ar: وَاِذَاۤ اَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَی الۡاِنۡسَانِ اَعۡرَضَ وَنَاٰ بِجَانِبِہٖ ۚ وَاِذَا مَسَّہُ الشَّرُّ فَذُوۡ دُعَآءٍ عَرِیۡضٍ ﴿۵۲﴾
verses.en: [✲]And when We bestow a favour on man, he goes away, turning aside; but when evil touches him, lo! he starts offering long prayers.

verses.ar: قُلۡ اَرَءَیۡتُمۡ اِنۡ کَانَ مِنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰہِ ثُمَّ کَفَرۡتُمۡ بِہٖ مَنۡ اَضَلُّ مِمَّنۡ ہُوَ فِیۡ شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِیۡدٍ ﴿۵۳﴾
verses.en: Say, ‘Tell me: if it is from Allah but you disbelieve in it — who is more astray than one who has drifted away from Allah?’

verses.ar: سَنُرِیۡہِمۡ اٰیٰتِنَا فِی الۡاٰفَاقِ وَفِیۡۤ اَنۡفُسِہِمۡ حَتّٰی یَتَبَیَّنَ لَہُمۡ اَنَّہُ الۡحَقُّ ؕ اَوَلَمۡ یَکۡفِ بِرَبِّکَ اَنَّہٗ عَلٰی کُلِّ شَیۡءٍ شَہِیۡدٌ ﴿۵۴﴾
verses.en: [✲]Soon We will show them Our Signs in all parts of the earth, and among their own people until it becomes manifest to them that it is the truth. Is it not enough that thy Lord is Witness over all things?

verses.ar: اَلَاۤ اِنَّہُمۡ فِیۡ مِرۡیَۃٍ مِّنۡ لِّقَآءِ رَبِّہِمۡ ؕ اَلَاۤ اِنَّہٗ بِکُلِّ شَیۡءٍ مُّحِیۡطٌ ﴿٪۵۵﴾
verses.en: Aye, they are surely in doubt concerning the meeting with their Lord. Aye, He certainly encompasses all things.
